acceptance: A Polars DataFrame run with --capture-plans records a fingerprint for every captured plan
A plan that differs between iterations of one query sets fingerprint_varied in the companion
description: Found 2026-11-11 while publishing the first plan-capture bundles. `benchbox run --platform polars-df --benchmark tpch --scale 0.1 --capture-plans` writes a plans companion with 22 entries whose `plan` is a dict of plan_text, plan_data, plan_type, optimization_hints and platform, with `plan_format: text` and no `fingerprint`. `_structure_dataframe_plan` (benchbox/platforms/dataframe/benchmark_mixin.py) asks the parser registry for `polars`, gets none, and returns the raw captured plan; `_apply_plan_fingerprints` only fingerprints a QueryPlanDAG. As a result `fingerprint_varied` and `fingerprint_variants` can never appear for Polars even though each query is captured on every iteration, and the Explorer stability warning cannot show for it. The published bundle tpch_sf01_polars_df_20261111_154204_3d7d3e84 shows this state (0 of 22 fingerprints). Decide between a Polars plan parser that yields a DAG and a text-plan fingerprint.
